description: Zones de stationnement en voirie is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Boulogne-Billancourt. This dataset makes it possible to have information on the parking areas of motorised vehicles type cars in the territory of Boulogne-Billancourt. This data was collected to allow citizens to know the location of parking spaces on the road. This also allows the municipality to visualise its coverage in terms of parking. Coverage: Ville de Boulogne-Billancourt. The portal shows the English title as "Parking areas by road" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Boulogne-Billancourt. Its keywords include amenagement-du-territoire-urbanisme, transports-deplacements-mobilite, challengedata, parking, zones-de-stationnement, mobilite. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2021-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
